# `mise dotfiles history describe`

- **用法：** `mise dotfiles history describe <REF> <TEXT>`
- **效果：** 修改状态
- **源代码：** [`src/cli/dotfiles/history/describe.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/dotfiles/history/describe.rs)

设置检查点的描述

## 参数
- **`<REF>`** — 数字检查点 ID、`latest`、`latest~N` 或 `commit:<sha>`
- **`<TEXT>`** — 新描述

## 标志
- **`-h --help`** — 打印帮助

## Examples

Describe the newest checkpoint

```
mise dot history describe latest "before the theme change"
```
